project.description: The name of the project to initialize.

projects.description: The list of projects to initialize.

dockerImageName.description: The name of the Docker image for the application.

dockerImageSuffix.description: The suffix to append to the Docker image name.

dockerImageRegistry.description: The Docker image registry to use.

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite existing files during initialization.

skipDocker.description: Whether to skip the Docker configuration setup.

skipFormat.description: Whether to skip formatting files with Prettier after initialization.

skipProjects.description: Whether to skip executing project-specific initialization logic.

authentik.description: Whether to initialize the Authentik Docker Compose setup.

standalone.description: Whether to initialize the workspace for standalone development.

minio.description: Whether to initialize the Minio Docker Compose setup.
